newsitem.title: UK: BT says no news on whether hit by UK windfall tax.
newsitem.headline: BT says no news on whether hit by UK windfall tax.

text.p: British Telecommunciations PLC is still unsure whether it will be included in the Labour government's planned windfall tax on privatised UK utility companies, a spokesman said on Sunday.
Commenting on a newspaper report in The independent on Sunday, the spokesman said "the fact remains that no formal statement has been on whether BT will be included in the windfall tax."
The paper had said BT would mount a legal challenge is subjected to a windfall levy of more than 250 million stg.

But the spokesman said its position remained unchanged and that it had not decided how much tax it would be prepared to pay before challenging any levy in the courts. It will take legal action if it considers itself "heavily hit," he said. Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown is expected to unveil details of the windfall tax at Wednesday's budget.
